prompt:
A photorealistic photograph of a medical check-up in a family doctor's practice in Berlin, in a tall vertical picture, caught in the middle of the examination. Taken with a 50 mm lens from a few metres away at the height of the patient's chest, looking straight at him, everything in sharp focus. Natural colours, soft even daylight.

The first two reference pictures show the same young man, from the front and in three-quarter view: his face and hair stay exactly as in them. The third reference picture shows his family doctor: her face, skin, hair and bun stay exactly as in it.

THE PATIENT stands in the middle of the picture, facing the camera, and fills most of its height: the top of his head sits just below the top edge, and his bare feet stand on the light-grey floor just above the bottom edge, with their shadow under them. He is the man of the first two reference pictures, with the same face and the same thick dark-brown curly hair; both of his ears show at the sides of his head. He has a fit, athletic build, like a man who plays football twice a week: defined shoulders and arms, a flat stomach, strong calves. He wears only plain dark navy-blue cotton boxer shorts. He stands straight with his weight on both feet, his feet a little apart with a band of floor between them, each toe visible. His two arms hang at his sides, each one a hand's width out from his body with a band of wall between arm and waist, his palms turned towards the camera, his hands open and empty, his fingers slightly spread. He keeps his head straight and his face turned towards the camera, as the doctor asked him to stand, and his eyes are turned sideways towards her, with a half-smile that reaches his eyes.

THE DOCTOR is the woman of the third reference picture: about forty, warm brown skin, dark-brown eyes, long black hair tied back in a low bun, in a white doctor's coat over a pale-blue blouse. She stands in the right part of the picture, beside him at arm's length, her whole body turned towards him and her eyes on him: her face in profile, attentive and friendly. She is listening to his chest: the earpieces of her black stethoscope are in her ears, and her hand nearer to him rests its round chest piece on the side of his chest nearer to her, just below his collarbone. Her other hand hangs empty at her side.

Behind the patient, against the wall in the left part of the picture, stands a white doctor's column scale: a flat white platform on the floor, a slim white column rising from it, and a white height rod rising above it to about the height of his head, with a small sliding head piece at its top. Its column and rod are plain, smooth white, marked only with fine grey ticks. The whole scale shows, between his arm and the left edge of the picture.

The wall is plain, painted an even soft sage green, with a white skirting board, and the floor is light-grey vinyl. Apart from the scale, the space between and around the two people is that same sage wall and grey floor, and the open floor runs on in front of them down to the bottom edge of the picture.
